scope: Synthetic F32 Llama correctness only. No speed measurement, registered-model validation, or adoption claim.

comparisons.full_rows: bitwise equality including each F32 payload
comparisons.row_picks: all five fields bitwise original versus partitioned
comparisons.ids: exact source-bound sampler and RNG state; conservative fallback to same full-row sampler
comparisons.cpu_oracle: independent finite/nonfinite semantic fields; signed-zero bits are compared only between actual kernels

required_gpu: Actual CUDA device, all layers GPU, tuned model path, successful graph execution and stable nonnull four-part scratch before capture/replay
default_preservation: Source-bound no-opt-in dispatch and existing CPU counters. Runtime deterministic rows/original selectors must match. Default nondeterministic whole-model repeatability is NOT established by this synthetic deterministic packet.
capture_and_fallback: Capture succeeds with persistent scratch; exercise pick/no-pick capture-key changes and actual graph-disabled HTTP fallback. Static dispatch counter proof is separate from actual GPU graph proof.
limits: No change to default flags or any full-adoption threshold.
Successful graph capture is evidence of exercised capture safety, not a general memory-lifetime proof.
Graph-disabled runtime fallback and CPU mocked counters have distinct scopes.

execution.launch: existing watchdog only after parent exact-pin review
execution.outputs: immutable per-leg files, atomic final report, retained single canonical raw home
execution.cleanup: normal relay HOME before owned pod and volume deletion; never clean unrelated resources
